patch.value: GH-1631: expose bounded extension-owned diagnostics on expected SDK errors

GitHub report https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1631 requests a namespaced JSON-compatible extension diagnostics slot on PmCliErrorContext and createPmCliExpectedError. Its concrete producer is pm-changelog issue 302: selection_report loses structure through host-owned prose fields. Design typed SDK and CLI/TOON/JSON contracts with size bounds and explicit exclusion from telemetry/Sentry; avoid widening arbitrary error payload capture.

Cover public SDK typing and separately bundled expected errors; preserve nested safe JSON diagnostics in JSON and TOON; enforce bounded output and prove telemetry/Sentry exclusion with real local collectors; coordinate pm-changelog producer adoption in its own repository.
Extensions return actionable structured refusal facts through a documented namespaced SDK field, with deterministic budgets and no diagnostic payload entering telemetry or Sentry.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Implementation (branch fix/refusal-contract-precision):

- Contract: PmCliErrorContext gains an optional details slot typed PmCliErrorDetails (plain JSON: null, booleans, finite numbers, well-formed strings, arrays, plain objects). New core module src/core/shared/error-details.ts admits a value, returns a detached copy, and renders it whole within PM_CLI_ERROR_DETAILS_LIMITS (max_bytes 4096 of compact UTF-8 JSON, max_depth 8). Anything larger or malformed is replaced by a details_omitted receipt { reason, path?, byte_length?, byte_limit }. Partial structures are never emitted.
- SDK: createPmCliExpectedError validates details at construction and throws a TypeError naming the reason and path (unsupported_value, non_finite_number, malformed_unicode, reserved_key for __proto__, depth_limit, not_plain_object). Size is data-dependent, so it is bounded at render time, not refused. Exports from sdk and sdk/runtime: PM_CLI_ERROR_DETAILS_LIMITS, isPmCliErrorDetails, PmCliErrorDetails, PmCliErrorDetailValue, PmCliErrorDetailsOmission, PmCliErrorDetailsRejection.
- CLI: --json errors carry details or details_omitted (kept by --lean). Text output renders an indented TOON "Details:" block, which is the first collection the bounded text ladder drops. The telemetry classification is built without details.
- MCP: errorContent and writeError now recognize separately bundled expected errors by shape (they previously forwarded context only for instanceof PmCliError) and bound details the same way.
- Sentry: captured faults strip details from error_context, and beforeSend scrubs details from error-data contexts and extras.

Proof: tests/unit/core/shared/error-details.spec.ts (17 cases), error-guidance, MCP, Sentry helper/instrument and SDK index specs. tests/integration/telemetry/extension-error-provenance.spec.ts runs the built CLI under Node and Bun against real local OTLP and Sentry collectors: the probe extension's separately bundled refusal carries a marked details payload, the JSON refusal returns it whole, the text refusal renders the Details block, and the marker never appears in collected events, logs or telemetry.

Producer adoption (pm-changelog selection_report) belongs in the pm-changelog repository once a pm-cli release ships this slot. Filed there as the follow-up after merge.

patch.value: Extensions return structured refusal facts through a documented SDK field, bounded deterministically and never sent to telemetry or Sentry.

PmCliErrorContext.details with SDK admission (TypeError on malformed shapes), whole-or-receipt rendering within PM_CLI_ERROR_DETAILS_LIMITS in JSON, text and MCP, and exclusion from telemetry classification and Sentry payloads.

A separately bundled refusal's details reach JSON and text output whole under Node and Bun, oversized payloads become details_omitted receipts, and real local OTLP and Sentry collectors never receive the payload.
Expected SDK errors carry bounded, producer-owned structured diagnostics
